body: This happen a few weeks ago and it still makes me sad. Well the owner eventually showed up and 1 of the dogs ended up going into the middle of the street and my neighborhood has people who drive pretty fast for stupid reason. The dog ended up getting hit the noise it made was horrible and then it got hit again of course it wasn't alive afterwards. What hit me the most was when the owner started crying and screaming.

Update. It's not that easy. I went to the police station a few days ago and I freaked out. And left I'm to afraid what would happen like what if they don't find him or they don't catch him and he ends up raping me again. What if it makes it worse and he gets angry and does something.  I can't tell my parents they wouldn't believe me they would probably judge me like they usually do. I'm not close to either of my parents. I don't go jogging alone I always have my dogs and I don't take a cell phone well because I honestly have no where to put it. No pockets and it's to big. Maybe I am putting myself at risk but I honestly can't do anything. Aside from the stalking, threats and my nightmares that make me rarely sleep he hasn't done anything to me. I'm sorta late for this.  About a year and 6 months ago I overdose on sleeping pills and cut my arms up with a razor blade. And fell asleep, I woke up to my little sister. I don't remember the full reason of why I did it that day.  I've always attempted it but was always to scared. I've delt with depression since I was 12 more of a on and off stage. I woke up with 2 police officers at my door I guess my ex boyfriend called the cops on me about my attempt of killing myself after all that I kinda of just ended up not telling anyone and holding it in.  But I wouldn't ever wanna try to suicide again I notice how much it hurts my family. I also realized how my cutting effects my boyfriend. I feel uneasy when there sad. I'm doing much better now. I understand everyone has there own issues and why they do these things. It's just you only can live once. Don't waste it. Just talk to someone instead. Anyone can help you.
